question: What do the sources say about whether highlighting text while reading reliably improves comprehension?
required_claim: Highlighting alone shows weak or mixed effects; active retrieval is reported as stronger.

passages.text: Library opening hours were extended during finals week.
A weather station near campus recorded unusually humid exam mornings.
Review note H: Across several classroom studies, highlighting alone produced small or inconsistent comprehension gains compared with re-reading.
The registrar published a new course-add deadline calendar.
Review note I: Practice tests and free recall (retrieval practice) were associated with larger comprehension and retention gains than highlighting.
A dormitory energy audit found higher electricity use in winter.
Parking permit prices increased by a small fixed amount.
